desc: Exhaustively compare candidate-distance feasibility with brute-force Manhattan-distance selection on small instances.
Prove that every optimal answer for \(k \ge 4\) is at most `side`.
Validate the perimeter-distance lemma for all boundary-point configurations, including opposite sides.
Confirm binary-search bounds, circular greedy correctness, and complexity for \(n \le 15000,\ k \le 25\).
